title: Launch Mission Lattice & Runway
content:
Summary:
A compact operational lattice that ties upcoming roadmap items to measurable launch signals and explicit backstops. Designed for quick go/no-go decisions during preflight and daily rollouts.

Intent:
- Make one source of truth for cross-functional launch signals and the minimum gating criteria.
- Highlight top-5 risks per initiative with owners and mitigations.
- Keep a concise contingency matrix that non-engineering stakeholders can read.

Current snapshot:
- Tracking lanes: API rate controls, Dedicated autoscale, Private VPC provisioning, Console UI variants.
- Next gate: API rate control canary start 2026-03-18.
- Health: 3 lanes green, 1 amber (private provisioning infra blockers).
- KPIs watched: p95 latency, error rate %, cost per 1k tokens, onboarding success %, canary adoption %.

KPI lattice (format: Epic | Owner | Launch target | Progress | KPIs & targets | Signals g/a/r | Backstop):
1) API rate controls | Michael Chen | 2026-03-18 | 78% | p95 <120ms; error <0.5% | green: p95<120 & err<0.5; amber: p95 120-200 or err 0.5-1.5; red: p95>200 or err>1.5 | backstop: autoscale pool + route to legacy model
2) Dedicated autoscale | Priya Nair | 2026-04-02 | 44% | throughput >=12k reqs/min; avg GPU util 50-75% | green: throughput>=12k & util 50-75; amber: 8-12k or util 75-85; red: <8k or util>85 | backstop: reserve static capacity, delay rollout
3) Private VPC provisioning | Ethan Brooks | 2026-03-25 | 31% | onboarding success >90%; provision time <2h | green: success>90 & <2h; amber: 70-90 or 2-6h; red: <70% or >6h | backstop: pause automated onboarding; manual assist
4) Console UI rollout (A/B) | Sofia Romero | 2026-03-30 | 61% | canary adoption lift >=5%; errors <0.2% | green: lift>=5 & err<0.2; amber: 2-5% or err 0.2-0.6; red: <2% or err>0.6 | backstop: rollback UI flag

Preflight checklist (must be green before canary):
- Feature flags in place (owner: devexp)
- Runbook in Slack #launch-mission-control (owner: product-ops)
- Canary routing tested (owner: infra)
- Perf regression harness green (owner: applied-ml)
- Finance cost review complete (owner: finance)
- Compliance/legal for Private flows signed off (owner: security-and-compliance)

Contingency matrix (failure mode -> immediate signal -> triage -> short-term backstop -> mid-term fix -> owner):
- Slow p95 after ramp -> p95 in amber/red -> open incident -> enable autoscale + reduce batch sizes -> kernel tuning / quantization patch -> serving-runtime team
- Private onboarding failures -> onboarding success <70% -> notify CS + solutions-eng -> pause automated onboarding; manual setup -> fix infra templates + release -> solutions-eng / customer-success
- Unexpected cost spike -> cost per 1k tokens >1.8x forecast -> alert finance/product -> throttle non-critical workloads; restrict burst -> batching and quant profiles -> infra/optimize team
- Telemetry gaps -> missing traces or metrics -> halt rollout -> enable debug hooks for canary -> improve tracing/sampling -> observability team

Roles and short on-call rotation:
- Mission lead: Asha Patel (overall go/no-go)
- Incident commander (first 24h): Michael Chen
- Customer escalation lead: Priya Nair
- Observability lead: Sofia Romero
- Infra on-call: SRE rotation (see oncall-sre-rotations)

Daily rollout cadence:
- 09:00 quick mission stand (15m)
- 12:00 deep sync if amber (30m)
- 17:00 day close (15m)
- Continuous: #launch-mission-control Slack thread for decisions

Open questions:
- Ramp schedule: propose conservative 1%,5%,20%,50%,100% with 24h between jumps unless all KPIs green. Can infra support faster jumps?
- Confirm fallback budget for Dedicated autoscale with finance by 2026-02-28.
- Final sign-off authority for Private-VPC canary: propose solutions-eng + customer-success.

Next actions (owner - deliverable - due):
- Michael: complete rate-limiter perf harness and post results - 2026-03-09
- Priya: propose fallback SLA and cost estimate for reserved capacity - 2026-02-25
- Ethan: deliver manual-provision runbook and unblock templating POC - 2026-02-24
- Sofia: register A/B telemetry IDs and confirm cohort instrumentation - 2026-03-02

Notes (informal):
- This lattice blends tactical runbook items with top-level KPIs so PMs and SREs can work from one page.
- We'll extract a customer-facing checklist after launch.
- See related: roadmap-slate-2026 (Confluence), q1-launch-budget-forecast (sheet).

Changelog:
- 2025-11-07 initial draft (Asha)
- 2025-12-15 added Dedicated autoscale KPIs (Priya)
- 2026-01-23 added contingency matrix and roles (Michael)
- 2026-02-20 updated progress numbers and moved Private-VPC target (Ethan)
